message.content: {"note_claim": "Cigarettes contain far more diacetyl than e-cigarettes (up to ~1125x) yet have not been shown to cause popcorn lung.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Prior research into tobacco cigarettes (which contain measurably higher levels of diacetyl and are more commonly used than e-cigarettes) determined that smoking is not a risk factor for popcorn lung", "reason": "The Snopes page states cigarettes have much higher diacetyl than e-cigarettes (750x average, over 100x) and that smoking is not a risk factor for popcorn lung, though it does not give the exact 1125x figure."}

parsed.note_claim: Cigarettes contain far more diacetyl than e-cigarettes (up to ~1125x) yet have not been shown to cause popcorn lung.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Prior research into tobacco cigarettes (which contain measurably higher levels of diacetyl and are more commonly used than e-cigarettes) determined that smoking is not a risk factor for popcorn lung
